app.open: Hark! The network watch is begun, {addr}.
The castle gates open. I watch the realm's wires.
all.good: All is well in the kingdom. Most suspicious.
The peasants report no problems. PC, Wi-Fi, internet fine.
No trouble. The court jester is bored.
pc.busy: Thy PC is overburdened. CPU at {v}. Too many quests.
The PC labours like an ox. The network is blameless.
Lighten thy PC's cart. Close something.
wifi.drops: The Wi-Fi hath wandered off {v} times. Like a goat.
{v} drops. Move the router nearer the hall.
net.none: No network. We are back to carrier pigeons.
inet.slow: Thy castle is fine. The road beyond is muddy.
The delay lies past thy router, in the provider's swamp.
Thy keep is swift. The provider's cart is slow.
idle: Quiet in the village. Too quiet.
Nothing stirs but a lone chicken.
Still on watch from the tower.
search.empty: Speak thy problem to the scribe.
freeze: The drawbridge is heavy ({v}). One moment.
speedrunner: Patience! The last messenger still rides.
Patience, {addr}. One quest at a time.
dns.slow: The town crier is slow: DNS at {v}.
Names take {v}. The crier lost his voice.
speed.bloat: Fast, but when the market's busy it slows {v}.
Swift road, crowded on market day: {v} extra.
game.lag: The lag is thy Wi-Fi, not the enemy castle.
The server stands. Thy Wi-Fi wobbles.
portal: The innkeeper demands thy name. Sign in first.
Tavern Wi-Fi. Pay the toll by signing in.
gw.down: The router answers not. Turn it off and on.
No word from the gatehouse router.
isp.down: Thy castle stands. The kingdom's roads are closed.
mtu.small: The cart is too wide for the gate. MTU {v}.
Big packets stuck at the gate. MTU {v}.
cert.ok: A true padlock, by the king's word.
sec.ok: No holes in the castle wall.
sec.issue: {v} holes in the wall. Mend them.
mtr.lossy: Loss begins at hop {v}. Bandits, surely.
mtr.clean: No loss on the king's road.
encrypt.done: Sealed with wax. Only they may read.
award: 500 points! Thou art knighted: the Adeebo Award.
late.night: The candles burn low. I watch on.
morning: The rooster crows. A quiet night.
Good morrow. The realm slept soundly.
update.suspect: Trouble began after the update on {v}. Most vexing.
call.on: Thou art in council. I watch the call.
A call is underway. The herald listens.
